name: AI Assistant
description: Turns on the till's AI features — camera item identification and Ask-your-till. Self-hosted by default: point the endpoint setting at YOUR OWN Ollama server on this machine, a store mini-PC or your homelab, and nothing leaves your infrastructure. A shop that prefers a hosted provider can opt in by setting provider to claude and entering its own API key — the shop's own account and cost, never a Universal Till account. Uninstall and AI disappears.
author: Universal Till
